notes: Prostacyclin Receptor Agonist In Pulmonary Arterial Hypertension. Primary endpoint (death/PAH complication) reduced 40% (HR 0.60, p<0.001). First oral prostacyclin pathway drug. Actelion trial.

Initial Use of Ambrisentan plus Tadalafil in PAH. Upfront combination reduced clinical failure 50% (HR 0.50, p<0.001). First trial proving upfront combination superior to monotherapy. Changed treatment paradigm.
Study with an Endothelin Receptor Antagonist in PAH. Macitentan reduced morbidity/mortality 45% (HR 0.55, p<0.001). Endothelin pathway. FDA approved. Actelion's follow-on to bosentan.
Riociguat for PAH. Improved 6MWD +36m (p<0.001). First soluble guanylate cyclase stimulator. Works via NO-independent pathway. Bayer trial. Also approved for CTEPH.
Bosentan Randomized trial of Endothelin Antagonist THErapy. FIRST oral endothelin receptor antagonist. Improved 6MWD +44m, clinical worsening reduced. Launched endothelin pathway targeting.
Sildenafil Use in Pulmonary Arterial Hypertension. PDE5 inhibitor. Improved 6MWD +45m (p<0.001). Repurposed erectile dysfunction drug. First PDE5i approved for PAH. Pfizer REVATIO.
Aerosolized Iloprost Randomized. Inhaled prostacyclin analog. Improved 6MWD +36m, NYHA class. Alternative to IV epoprostenol (which requires continuous infusion). Schering trial.
Oral treprostinil in PAH. Clinical worsening reduced 32% (HR 0.68, p=0.04). Oral prostacyclin option - better than continuous IV. United Therapeutics.
